gallery.description: Three tethered balloons are released and rise or sink by their buoyancy; a 1.5 m/s wind starts at 2.0 s.
A ball is launched into a pile of blocks.
A thin plate is released above a ball and falls under air drag that depends on its orientation.
A gripper throws a ball that a central attractor then pulls onto a curved path.
A ball is pushed into a cluster of balls, which scatter (cue ball material changed from wood to plastic).
A ball is pushed into a set of pins (ball material changed from rubber to wood).
A piston pushes a four-wheeled cart with cargo toward a spring buffer.
A ball is dropped into a heap of grains, which scatter over the floor (ball mass doubled).
A ball and a hoop race down a ramp to a backstop (the third racer, a cylinder, is removed in this branch).
A 38 kg cabinet is tipped over and sheds the books and the vase on it.
The first chair of a row is pushed at the top of its back and the row falls like dominoes.
A spring-loaded plunger is let go and fires a ball into a tower of blocks (ball mass x0.6).
A pendulum is released into a tower of 18 blocks; an extra impulse hits the bob at 1.0 s.
A table is tipped over and the items on it slide off.
A row of nine books on a table is toppled; the last book sends a ball off the edge into a box.
An armchair is pushed into a table (gravity x0.6).
A chair is thrown onto a table.
A crate is released above a small table and lands on it (crate material changed from wood to plastic).
Two masses joined by two springs are displaced and let go, and oscillate together.
A double pendulum swings (gravity x0.6).
A ball is released above an elastic net of linked panels and bounces off it.
A mass on a spring is released and oscillates (empty room).
A ball released at the top of a ramp hits a spring-mounted bumper, which topples a row of dominoes.
A trigger pin is pulled and a spring-driven arm throws a ball (spring stiffness halved).
A piston presses one end of a lever down and the cargo on the other end is thrown up.
Two tyres roll toward one another, collide and knock over two stacks of boxes.
A ball is launched into a curved track and follows it around.
An object is released, falls and bounces (gravity x1.34).
A ball is thrown; gravity changes during the motion.
A model rocket is released and driven by its thrust.
A block is spun on the floor; the tool's force changes at 0.55 s.
A spinning top is spun and released (material changed from plastic to rubber).
A ball is pushed into a second ball; an extra impulse hits the target ball at 1.2 s.
A ball is released on a ramp and rolls down (ball mass doubled).
A block is pushed and slides to rest (material changed from wood to plastic).
A wheel is set spinning on the floor and goes from slipping to rolling (material changed from rubber to wood).
A ball is pushed into a chain of bodies that collide one after another.
The first domino of a branching network is pushed over (mass of one end ball x3).
A raised pendulum bob is released into a tower on a pedestal; blocks and a ball fall into a box.
A support block is pulled out from under a pile; an extra impulse hits the top beam at 1.5 s.
The first of a row of dominoes is pushed over.
A ball is pushed across a table into a block, and both fall off the edge toward a box.
A chair with a ball on its seat is tipped over; an extra impulse hits the ball at 1.2 s.
A ball is released above the free end of a flexible board, which flicks it toward a box.
A ball is released onto a flexible bridge and rolls toward a box.
A pendulum is thrown into its swing (bob shape changed to a cube).
A pendulum bob is thrown into a spring-mounted block (bob shape changed to a cube).
A hanging chain is thrown into motion (one link removed).
A heavy ball rolls down a ramp onto a lever, which launches a second ball.
A crank is spun and drives a slider; an extra impulse hits the slider at 1.5 s.
Two loads on a pulley are released; an extra impulse hits one load at 0.25 s.
A block is pushed along its guide (block mass x0.79).
A beam carrying a ball is spun about its axle (gravity x1.4).
A rod is set spinning; masses pulled inward make it spin faster.
A ball is launched along the slope of a funnel and spirals down.
A ball is thrown at a second ball next to a box.

gallery_note: PhysX recordings of all 56 motion families, one record each, path-traced and cropped to the action; 27 are marked as featured. The orange arm is a drawing that follows the recorded end effector. A caption states the change of the record where it is not the factual run.

channels.note: RGB, metric depth, instance masks, optical flow and scene flow of saved PhysX states of training records, replayed with physics off. Depth and instance ids come from the renderer together with the RGB frame; the flows are computed from depth, ids and the exact saved poses. The floor colour and the lights are set at render time only.

optical_flow_wheel.reads: the colour at a point of the disc is the colour of a flow vector pointing from the centre to that point (x right, y down, as in the image); the rim is the saturation magnitude stated for the clip, white is no motion

depth_bar.reads: left end: the near distance stated for the clip, right end: the far distance; black: no depth

scene_flow_axes.reads: three bars for world x (red), y (green) and z (blue, up): left end minus the saturation magnitude stated for the clip, middle zero (grey), right end plus; the tile adds the three channels

depth.definition: distance along the optical axis (camera Z), not radial distance

instances.definition: one colour per object: movable bodies vivid, fixed furniture muted, the room shell dark grey

optical_flow.colour_map: Middlebury colour wheel: hue the direction, saturation the magnitude, white no motion
optical_flow.note: measured at the rendered resolution 1920 x 1080; the tile shows a 1708 x 960 part of it

scene_flow.unit: metres per frame in the world frame (Z up)
scene_flow.colour_map: red x, green y, blue z; mid-grey no motion

channels.undefined: black: no depth, or the cosmetic arm housing (a drawing without a pose in the record)
